title: Tammy Chambless Explains Her 0DTE Options Iron Condor Strategy
summary: Tammy Chambless (a well-known retail 0DTE backtester; did not invent MEIC) presents the Multiple-Entry Iron Condor and her 'MEIC plus' tweak: SPX 0DTE, 6 iron condors/day 30-60 min apart, $1-1.75 credit/side, 50-100 wide, per-side stop at 1x net (=2x credit), 2%-of-account daily risk cap. Best-evidenced 0DTE IC in this KB: near-complete reproducible mechanics, a BYOB 1-min backtest (33.3% CAR, 7.4% maxDD, Calmar 4.5, Jan2023-Sep2025) reconciled against a lower live record (~20.7% avg, live UNDER backtest = anti-oversell), and genuine quantified slippage/broker-stop-handling rigor. Still self-reported (not audited), a benign 2023-2025 regime, crowded VRP-harvesting family (same as Yona/Pulver), and 0DTE-intraday so not faithfully testable on our EOD stack. Write-up: strategies/tammy_chambless_0dte_ic.md (conviction 2.5/5).
